content.tagline: Dermatology-clinic skincare from Korea, across three brands
content.descriptor: Korean dermatology-clinic group: three brands — AGAFAR skincare, agapharma Meditive Formula 3X, a'reiv — and a line of in-clinic professional devices
about: AGAFAR is a Korean dermatology-clinic and skincare brand that has worked since 2010. Its official clinic website lists six AGAFAR clinics in Korea: Mia, Seongnam, Gwangmyeong, Gimpo, Gyeyang and Juan. According to the company, AGAFAR Clinic and AGAFAR Medi Lounge also operate in Hong Kong, China, Thailand and Canada, with more than 40 branches in Korea and abroad in total. AGAFAR presented its DERMA MODE PROGRAM catalog under the AGAFAR, agapharma and a'reiv names at K-Beauty Expo Korea 2026.

According to the company, AGAFAR derma-cosmetics were created for gentle daily care of sensitive and problem-prone skin. AGAFAR has three brands in the derma skincare direction. AGAFAR is the daily-care line: cleanser, toner, ampoules, eye care, moisturizer and sunblock. agapharma is the professional Meditive Formula 3X line, built on hyal-collagen and Bio Lacto Exosome: cleanser, ampoule, skin booster and creams. a'reiv is a laboratory-coded sheet mask and a calming sun cream. The EXOXEN booster (a high-concentration exosome product) and NADXEN (an NAD⁺/NMN ampoule and serum) are labelled on the company's official site as "AGAFAR EXOXEN" and "AGAFAR NADXEN" — products of the AGAFAR brand, not separate brands; the company's own DERMA MODE PROGRAM catalog confirms the same structure, listing exactly three brands (agafar, agapharma, a'reiv) with EXOXEN as a catalog item.

AGAFAR also makes a line of professional in-clinic and salon devices — its official "Skincare & Body Contouring Devices" catalog lists seven. Transfer is a basic multi-function device (a 27 kHz ultrasonic scrubber, a Sono handpiece vibrating 1 million times per second, a Vitamin Clip for iontophoresis, and a Cooling & Heating handpiece at −20…+40 °C). agafar Point Plus is HIFU (7 MHz at 1.5/2/3/4/5 mm and 4 MHz at 3/4.5/6/9 mm) plus LDM ultrasound (3/10 MHz and 1/3 MHz). The RF + HIFU device is named agafar Point Plus Pro on its detail page in the same catalog, but the catalog's own overview grid labels it "AGAFAR POINT PLUS RPO" — a naming discrepancy inside one official document, left unresolved rather than guessed at; it has 2/3/4.5 mm face cartridges, a 6 mm body cartridge, and a rated 180,000 shots. agafar Line S is a 6-in-1 device (multipolar RF, thermal RF, 34 kHz cavitation, low-level laser, vacuum and LED, via Thermal, Multi Cavi and Multi handpieces). agafar S combines cavitation, a thermal handpiece and a suction handpiece (APP-1/2/3). PLASMA is a plasma device with AIR Plasma and RF Multi Plasma handpieces; the unit itself is labelled "PLASER". agafar LED PDT Light offers red 635 nm, green 560 nm, blue 415 nm and a combined light (purple 308 nm, yellow 590 nm, orange 610 nm). Separately, a photo from the company's exhibition booth shows a device called PLAZION with the claims "Better Absorption" and "Deeper Penetration"; this name does not appear in the official "agafar dermatology machines" catalog, and no technical specification or registration status has been provided.

According to the company, AGAFAR products are sold in Korea, Hong Kong, China, Thailand, Japan, the US, the Philippines, Malaysia, the UK, the UAE (Dubai), Canada and other markets. These are the company's own statements, confirmed for a specific enquiry, not independently verified by Teranova.
facts: Three brands in the derma skincare direction: AGAFAR, agapharma (Meditive Formula 3X), a'reiv; the EXOXEN and NADXEN boosters are AGAFAR-brand products, according to the official site and the company's catalog
Six AGAFAR dermatology clinics in Korea, listed on the official clinic website; working since 2010
More than 40 clinic branches in Korea and abroad, including Hong Kong, China, Thailand and Canada, according to the company
20-SKU DERMA MODE PROGRAM catalog: cleansers, toners, ampoules, eye care, creams, sunblock, sheet mask, boosters

Up to seven professional devices in the official device catalog: Transfer, Point Plus (HIFU+LDM), Point Plus Pro/RPO (RF+HIFU), Line S (6-in-1), agafar S (cavitation/thermal/vacuum), PLASMA, LED PDT Light
Product markets according to the company: Korea, Hong Kong, China, Thailand, Japan, US, Philippines, Malaysia, UK, UAE, Canada and others
catalog_notes: All-in-one cleansing gel with portulaca and madecassoside that removes makeup and impurities without tightness.
Toner with betaine and chia seed extract that balances skin after cleansing and preps it for the next steps.
Soothing gel with green tea, propolis and licorice root for sensitive, irritated skin; doubles as an overnight mask.
Brightening ampoule with a vitamin A/C/E complex for dull, uneven skin tone.
Firming ampoule with an 8-peptide and collagen complex for mature, dehydrated skin.
PDRN and multi-molecular hyaluronic acid ampoule for deep hydration and radiance.
Soothing, brightening ampoule with a Vita K complex and azulene for sensitive skin.
Eye serum with a red berry complex and collagen for firmness around the eyes.
Daily eye cream with Lactobacillus ferment and peptides for elasticity and firmness.
Barrier-repair spot cream with madecassoside and a ceramide complex for damaged skin.
All-skin-type base cream with ceramide and cholesterol that preps skin for active steps.
Lightweight daily sunblock with a multi-peptide complex and no white cast.
4-free foam cleanser built on the Meditive Formula 3X complex for sensitive and combination skin.
Daily ampoule combining Meditive Formula 3X and 5-free probiotics for barrier and microbiome care.
Single-dose skin booster for use after laser treatments or with in-clinic devices.
Light, non-sticky cream with patented moisturizers for all skin types.
Rich regenerating cream for post-treatment care after laser or peeling.
High-concentration exosome booster for post-procedure and in-clinic skin renewal.
Ultra-fine sheet mask with triple hyaluronic acid for dry, sensitive skin.
Matte-finish sun cream for oily, sensitive skin that doubles as a makeup primer.

lines.name: AGAFAR
lines.note: The flagship daily-care line: Mild Cleansing Gel, Balancing Soothing Toner and Eliderm soothing gel, four Pro Ampoules (Mela brightening, Double firming, PDRN-HA, Vita K), Shine Eye Serum and Star Eye Cream, Oint spot-recovery cream, Moisturizing Cream and a Daily Sunblock SPF50+ PA++++. According to the official site, the EXOXEN exosome booster and the NADXEN NAD⁺/NMN ampoule and serum also belong to the AGAFAR brand, not to separate brands.

lines.name: agapharma
lines.note: Meditive Formula 3X, agapharma's professional line: a gentle foam cleanser, an active ampoule, a 7-ampoule skin booster, a light cream and a regenerating cream, built around a Hyal-Collagen, Bio Lacto Exosome and Super Centella complex.

lines.name: a'reiv
lines.note: A Hyaluronic Ultra-Fine sheet mask (Lab Laboratory Mask) and a Calming Sun Cream SPF50+ PA++++ for oily and sensitive skin.

tech.name: Transfer
tech.note: A basic multi-function clinic device: a 27 kHz ultrasonic scrubber, a Sono handpiece (1 million vibrations per second), a Vitamin Clip for iontophoresis, and a Cooling & Heating handpiece (−20…+40 °C). Per the company's official device catalog.

tech.name: agafar Point Plus
tech.note: HIFU + LDM: HIFU at 7 MHz (1.5/2/3/4/5 mm) and 4 MHz (3/4.5/6/9 mm), LDM ultrasound at 3/10 MHz and 1/3 MHz. Per the company's official device catalog.

tech.name: agafar Point Plus Pro
tech.note: RF + HIFU; the overview grid in the same catalog labels it "AGAFAR POINT PLUS RPO" — a discrepancy inside one official document, left unresolved rather than guessed at. 2/3/4.5 mm face cartridges, a 6 mm body cartridge, rated 180,000 shots.

tech.name: agafar Line S
tech.note: 6-in-1: multipolar RF, thermal RF, 34 kHz cavitation, low-level laser, vacuum and LED, via three handpieces — Thermal, Multi Cavi, Multi. Per the company's official device catalog.

tech.name: agafar S
tech.note: Cavitation + thermal + suction: Protrusion, Cavitation and Suction & Thermal handpieces (APP-1/2/3). Per the company's official device catalog.

tech.name: PLASMA
tech.note: The unit itself is labelled "PLASER"; AIR Plasma and RF Multi Plasma handpieces. Per the company's official device catalog.

tech.name: agafar LED PDT Light
tech.note: Red 635 nm, green 560 nm, blue 415 nm and a combined light (purple 308 nm, yellow 590 nm, orange 610 nm). Per the company's official device catalog.

tech.name: PLAZION
tech.note: An in-clinic device from a photo of the company's exhibition booth, with the claims "Better Absorption" and "Deeper Penetration" and an intensity dial; this name does not appear in the official "agafar dermatology machines" catalog. Teranova has not received a technical specification, model name or registration status for it.

tech.name: Clinical actives
tech.note: The DERMA MODE PROGRAM catalog is built around PDRN, multi-peptide and hyaluronic-acid complexes, exosomes, Centella asiatica, ceramides and ferment-based actives, with volume and key ingredients stated per product in the company's own catalog.

tech.name: Clinic-linked development
tech.note: According to the company, AGAFAR's formulas follow prescriptions and recommendations from its dermatology clinics; Teranova has not independently verified this claim.
